csv_project_name: AE for Bozeman Yellowstone International Airport
csv_scope_of_work: The Gallatin Airport Authority is seeking Statements of Qualifications from interested and qualified aviation consultants to provide professional airport engineering and architectural services. Work contemplated by the Authority include: Taxiway C relocation Widening and lengthening RWY 11/29 Development of the northside for General Aviation Development of a new Quick Turn Facility for car rental companies Engineering associated with expansion/ relocation of airport roads and parking lots Development of new parking garage Administration of Airport s DBE program Administration and engineering associated with airfield pavement maintenance and rehabilitation including, but not limited to, fog seal, overlay, and re-striping of runways, taxiways and aprons. Administration of other federal programs including Passenger Facility Charge Federal grant administration Relocation of electronic navigation systems Other incidental airport engineering, architectural, and technical support services, as may be required.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
